Name: Creepy Cat Collection
Author: tiakall
Description:
They have descended upon Stardew Valley: a horde of black cats, some benign, some bizarre.  Can you find them all?

Made for the Stardew Discord mod jam.  Includes 100 black cats with weird names, a book to catalogue them in, a couple of spooooooky letters, and Pelican Town being a little out of sorts.  The cats can be found everywhere, except Ginger Island (it's too humid.)

Is this compatible with: I tried to keep in mind NPC/map patches where possible when hiding cats, so probably compatible with quite a lot.  SVR3 I'm not too sure about since I'm not that familiar with their maps, and SVE makes so many changes that probably some cats will end up inside walls or bushes. ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

Possible future updates:
* MOAR CATS FOR THE CAT GOD
* additional letters or events for cataloguing cats
* rewards??
* redistributing/reorganizing some cats - a lot of them are pretty easy to find since I made a number of spawns guaranteed daily for the sake of modjam judging. And I kind of want to put them in order of increasing unhingedness.

Credits:
* The art comes from [url=https://bowpixel.itch.io/]Bow.Pixel on Itch.io[/url]; their adorable Sedentary Cats pack is what inspired this mod.
* [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/108727003]KediDili[/url] for making Creaturebook, a super cool and underrated framework.
* Elizabeth and the other modjam organizers for getting me to actually sit down and make this.
* Vinilla, sheku, and ichor in #makingmods who answered my newb questions from speedrunning learning two frameworks in one weekend.
